services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Come spend the day on our Sweetwater 26 foot Tritoon, 12 passenger boat for the best boat trip on Lake of the Ozarks. Each of our boats is equipped with a Yamaha 150 HP engine. Customize your boat with tubing, wakeboarding, or even lounge on the lake with one of our aqua mats. Enjoy discounted rates when you book a 4-hour rental up to a full 8-hour day! Multi day (overnight) rentals are available by calling our team (not available through online booking). Wanting to let someone else do the work for you? blurb: Guests rent boats, waverunners, paddleboards, and kayaks to explore Lake of the Ozarks. Guided fishing trips and parasailing flights are also available. Safety instructions and temporary boating licenses can be obtained on site or online.
extraNote: $600 security deposit required for boat rentals, $300 for waverunners, on major credit/debit card · Sales tax and fuel not included in rental prices · Cancellations must be made by phone only; weekday rentals require 48 hours notice, weekends and holidays 7 days · Refunds exclude service or processing fees · Inclement weather refunds require agreement on definition of inclement weather · State of the art marina at 1100 Bagnell Dam Boulevard, Lake Ozark, MO
